LanguageData.LP_AbyssCircle.label: abyssal circle
LanguageData.LP_AbyssCircle.description: A 5×5 dark red rune circle inlaid in the floor with silver and cold iron. Hold abyssal rituals here to summon demons: tier 1 manes swarms and quasits, tier 2 barlguras and hezrous, tier 3 succubi / incubi, nabassus (and mariliths), tier 4 balors. Tier 2 and above require first reading a demonology tome that records that demon. Souls can also be refined here. Only one per map.\n\nYou can spend another 40 silver on a silver rim: +5% success chance.
LanguageData.LP_BindingCircle.label: binding circle
LanguageData.LP_BindingCircle.description: A 3×3 silver chain rune. When a bound one's bed is on the circle (or right next to it), obedience +3 per day. Outsider prisoners wearing a planar anchor chain will not escape from a room with a binding circle, and demon blood can only be drawn in such a room. At most 4 per map.
LanguageData.LP_WardingGlyph.label: exorcism ward
LanguageData.LP_WardingGlyph.description: A silver rune carved into the floor. Within 6 cells: hostile outsiders move ×0.7; people sleeping inside lose 1% abyssal taint per day; planar rifts will not open here. Each ward on the map lowers planar thinness by 1 per day (up to 5 count).
